keyword: when was the last moon mission

verifications.claim: The last time humans went to the moon was during NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Apollo 17 was the sixth and final Apollo mission to land people on the moon.'; R3: 'Apollo 17 — the final mission in the program, which was the last time humans traveled to the moon.'; R4: 'the last crewed mission to the Moon was Apollo 17'; R7: 'They were the last humans to visit the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Apollo 17 as the last human moon mission.
